notes.title: v0.9.5
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version: 0.9.5[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Patch Notes have dates now
[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Branding change: ACP: Action Coin Pusher is now P&P: Push & Plunder
[*] New Pusher Type: Spinner
[*] New Enemy Type: Protector
[*] New Enemy Type: Medic
[*] New Enemy Type: Armorer
[*] New Enemy Type: Charger
[*] New Enemy Type: Floater
[*] New Enemy Type: Shooter
[*] New Enemy Type: Burster
[*] New Enemy Type: Sniper
[*] New Enemy Type: Mimic
[*] Player Movement is now separate from Coin Aiming
[*] Tables are now dynamic and swap out pieces over time
[*] There are now special events that can spawn during a run
[*] Added screenshake when explosions happen
[*] Added a Minimap that displays Baubles, Rewards, and Events
[*] Equipment can now have special unique effects
[*] Elites and Bosses are integrated with the Table Layer system and can change the board
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemy Baubles can now randomly be up to 20% stronger or weaker
[*] The Knight's Goliath Shot has been migrated to be an inate feature of the class, with a 5% chance to happen on every shot
[*] The Knight has a new Ability: Spike Ball
[*] The Knight has a new Class Feature: Shield
[*] The Mage & Rogue have undergone similar changes, but they're secret for now ;)
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rewrote the Music Manager to fade layers of tracks in and our dynamically
[*] Added Perfect and Weak shot chimes
[*] There is now custom made music for the game with more to come
[*] New boss alert noises that play when an Elite or Boss spawns
[/list]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Equipment Chest visuals changed to match other assets
[/list]
[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Repainted every interface in the entire game
[*] Added Damage Type Icons to the damage number pops
[*] Equipment Chest renamed to "Chest" to be more in line with other assets
[*] Improved the way you buy and open Coin Caches to reduce screen confusion
[*] Perks can have special description overrides that display for perks that do non-stat things
[*] Stacks on enemies are now visible above the HP bar when you aim at them
[*] Stacks on the player can now be examined on the pause menu
[*] Redesigned the Coin Charge Bar
[*] Redesigned the enemy HP/Armor bars
[/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Bauble Navigation AI, increasing FPS
[*] A Soft Coin Cap has been implemented to help contain the performance degradation from the physics engine over time
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Equipment Chests rewarding multiple times when pushed off the board
[*] Fixed some instances where player input could continue when the player is not inputting
[*] Fixed Elite Fliers from getting stuck hovering above the kill plane under the table
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some text on the Upgrades screen is not curving when it should
[*] Some enemies damage the player rapidly multiple times instead of just once when falling off the board
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] String Translation has been implemented, translations to come...
[/list]

notes.title: v0.9.4 - Elemental Coins
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version: v0.9.4[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the target system to make players more aware that it exists
[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new default Rune so players are more likely to understand the equipment system without tutorializing them
[*] Added several new hand-crafted equipment
[*] Added Health Crates that can spawn as a target reward
[*] Added new types of coins that can spawn
[*] -Fire, Damage over time
[*] -Acid, faster but lower damage DoT
[*] -Lightning, zaps a cluster of baubles
[*] -Sleep, turns the bauble ai off temporarily
[*] -Vampire, Returns a small percentage of damage done as health
[*] -Ice, Freezes enemy baubles in place
[*] Added visual flair to basic coins so they match the elmental coins 
[*] Added XP Magnet powerup
[*] Trash Objects now spawn rarely for additional visual interest
[*] Added Demi-Runes, Minor Relics, and Loops&Bands
[*] -These are randomly generated items with stat combos that cannot be obtained otherwise
[*] You can now equip up to 5 elemental coins
[*] Classes now have up to 5 Elemental Coins associated with them
[*] Coin Shop Added
[*] -You can now purchase 10 elemental coins for coins in the Coin Shop
[*] New Stat Type: Elemental Damage
[*] Added a new perk "Elementalist" which improves Elemental Damage
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Target Rewards can now include various additional buffs/rewards
[*] Fast Dummies and Rogue Skeletons size shunk by 20%
[*] Baseball Dummies and Warrior Skeletons size increased by 20%
[*] Golden Baubles now drop equipment chests
[*] Overcharge stat now applies to the rate at which overcharge builds in addition to maximum overcharge
[*] Equipment Chests spawn more frequently
[*] Knight no longer has a penalty to move speed
[*] Knight now has a penalty to Elemental Damage
[*] Mage no longer has a bonus to Crit Damage
[*] Mage now has a bonus to Elemental Damage
[*] Mage Perk "Magic Might" now also increases Elemental Damage
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Coins now play one of several random noises when they spawn
[/list]
[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Re-Implemented the ability charge meter on the main UI
[*] Redesigned the Health Bar to more accurately reflect that it is a pool of your health
[*] Removed the health number from the screen
[*] Fixed Inventory objects not fading when the equipment menu closes
[*] Made stat improvements more clear on equipment and perks
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Coin Size Stat not influencing the size of the coins
[*] Fixed a visual bug if you unequip an item that gives you max health
[/list]

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! Skylor here.[/h3]

I'm excited and proud to say that you can now play [b]Action Coin Pusher![/b] 😁 I’m thrilled to have you dive into all the [b]coin-flipping, bauble-popping madness[/b] I’ve been working so hard on. Trust me, this one’s packed with more polish and gameplay goodness than ever! I’ve lovingly crafted a [b]solid 2-3 hours[/b] of demo action, filled with the most satisfying coin launches you’ll experience all year! 🔥

The demo is a [u]permanent and standalone experience[/u] based on a build from about a month ago. Just a heads up—[b]your save won't carry over[/b] to the full game, and there may still be a few bugs [i](hey, what’s a demo without some surprises?)[/i], but I’m offering [b]a special in-game reward[/b] in the full release if you’ve played the demo! 🎁

Since I submitted the demo build for Next Fest, I’ve been hard at work crafting [b]new Tables, Classes, Enemies, Bosses, Equipment, Challenges,[/b] and [b]Upgrades![/b] 💪 Plus, I completely reworked the movement code and improved the general feel of the game —now the controls feel smoother than ever! It’s all about nailing that moment-to-moment feel, so you can really enjoy smashing through those bauble hordes. 💥

If you notice any bugs or have feedback you want to share, please drop it in the [b]Steam Community[/b]—I [b]actually read and appreciate[/b] all the feedback I get! 🙏

notes.title: v0.9.1 - The Graveyard
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version: v0.9.1[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Re-wrote the Movement system. It shouldn't be very noticable, but there may be some unintended balance changes due to minor differences in speeds between the classes
[*] Re-wrote the enemy wave generation system to make it easier to create new content for the game. As a result, all previous enemy data was lost. Balance will be different.
[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Table: The Graveyard, Unlock Via Debug Challenges
[*] New Perk: Power Surge: +Ability Power
[*] When Enemies are off the screen, but dangerously close to falling off the bottom, they now get a little spyglass to warn you.
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies are now only immune to damage from the last coins that hit them, instead of all damage entirely. This means you can hit the same bauble with multiple coins from the Rogues Scatter Shot and multishot
[*] Buffed Mage Perk: Magic Might: 10%->15%
[*] Buffed Mage Perk: Arcane Focus: 5%->8%
[*] Enemies no longer die at the end of the timer, and now the final wave continues forever as the boss fight begins
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a feedback sound for when the player tries to use their ability with no charges
[/list]
[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] The average earned coins/gems from the last 8 runs is now displayed next to the "history" button on the main menu
[*] Added the Coins Collected to the UI during a run, and updated how we track the gems and kills to remove prototype placeholder code
[*] Adjusted tooltips to avoid confusing players
[*] Combo Meter now uses the classes color
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shot Charge is no longer lost when activating Meteor
[*] Fixed Parameter values for Player Animations being set to very weird numbers
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] The "Demo" Table no longer works correctly. It has no proper boss fight, and is in the process of a major overhaul
[*] The new Golem Boss for Graveyard has not been balanced at all
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] During this table overhaul, the "close range" system started to cause some serious issues with the gameplay. We removed this system entirely as we feel the game plays better without it.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.9.0
notes.content:
[h1]This is the first Patch that will not be retroactively applied to the Demo. We are in the home stretch now![/h1]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version: v0.9.0[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Stat Type: Ability Power
[*] All Abilities now scale with Ability Power
[*] Added the Mage class, unlock via Debug Challenge Page for now
[*] New Ability: Meteor
[*] Added the Rogue Class, unlock via Debug Challenge Page for now
[*] New Ability: Scatter Shot
[*] The Player now has Visual upgrades for their equipment as they level up
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Goliath Shot now scales the size of the coin with the players Class Tier, based on their level. Level 0 = 2x size, Level 40 = 5x (full power)
[/list]
[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Players last chosen class and table is now remembered between sessions
[*] Charge Bonus Damage -> Charge Bonus
[*] Ability Charge Rate moved to Utility
[*] Shot Charge Rate moved to Utility
[*] Added two placeholder spots for planned upcomming classes
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Null reference when exploding baubles
[*] Fixed the Charge Animation for 1H Melee users causing the player to jitter
[*] Fixed The Patch Note Screen not fading like the rest of the menus
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] This patch introduces "Debug Challenges" which are special challenges that will not be in the final version of the game, used exclusively for testing. This will allow beta players to test and try out new content without me having to implement the content into the main meta progression.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8.11
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version: v0.8.11[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Challenge system was re-designed and expanded with more developer tools to make creating and tweaking challenges a little easier for me
[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a system for challenges that do not rely on trackable stats
[*] Added a framerate limit setting. Recent improvements in the game have cause my dev rig to go into overdrive and render 4-500 frames on the start menu, causing insane overheating.
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Knight Base Knockback increased from 150% -> 200%
[*] Knight base Shot Cooldown 0.9s->1.2s
[/list]
[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Further smoothing and polishing of the Historical Run Data screens
[*] End of Run Window is Purple when you lose, gold when you win
[/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Massively reduced garbage collection by reducing the number of times we calculate the players current stats. In testing this made the game go from 40fps to 125fps
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Equipment Tooltips in the End of Run display being strangely spaced and placed
[*] Fixed coins triggering on-hit effects multiple times per hit
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] A lot of things were changed in this patch, and your challenges will be broken. Reset your save file in the settings on the main menu to fix this.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8.10
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version: v0.8.10[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stats have been split into three types (Offensive/Defensive/Utility) for use in organization of UI elements and helping the player understand how they should be thinking about the stat.
[*] Player Defense is now called Armor
[/list]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*] The "near death" red now fades to black on death to reduce eye strain
[/list]
[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted font weights in Perk Displays and Equipment Tooltips
[*] Positive Stat changes are now gold, negative are now purple. This should be visible to most type of color vision variants
[*] End of Run screen now displays any challenges you earned during your run
[*] Unified the Historical Run data and End of Run screen gameobjects under one prefab
[*] Class menu layout redesigned with the new stat lists
[*] Redesigned the pause menu using the new stat lists
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an exploit where Baubles were getting caught in a nav-node loop in the corners of the board closest to the player
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] The deadzone is still noticable when baubles bottom halves are close enough but top halves are not
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8.9
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version: v0.8.9[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game should now award any challenge awards that the player may be missing at launch
[*] Adjusted the way that close range coins are handled to smooth out a "dead zone" where player coins would either fly over a bauble entirely, or hit the ground far too soon
[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the Patch Note format and creation. You guys probably won't notice much of a change but it's a big deal for me.
[*] Added a slight camera sway when moving left and right, with a toggle in the settings
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] All Meta Perks had their costs adjusted, since no one can play I'm not going to really break down how. They didn't have any balance before and now they have "some" balance
[/list]
[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Equipment menu slimmed up because it was bothering me
[*] Patch Notes Screen now only loads the five (5) most recent patches, and has a button at the bottom to load another 5 if the user feels inclined
[*] All stat values have had their tooltips adjusted
[*] Base stats are now always either a flat number, a %, or time
[*] Multiplier values are no longer displayed as % increases, to avoid confusion with base stats that are displayed as %s
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player character no longer gets stuck in the "charging shot" animation
[*] Fixed getting stuck leveling up too many times
[*] Fixed an issue where viewing historical run data would display un-initialized tooltips
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Invisible improvements to the EffectStack system in prep for future additions
[/list]
